summary: Inject control-flow prompt override when all tools in a step fail, forcing direct visual re-examination instead of uncritical acceptance of prior negative VQA consensus.

edits.hypothesis: Adding a next_prompt override when all requested tools fail prevents the agent from proceeding with low-confidence negative consensus by explicitly directing it to re-examine original pixels.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prompt edits alone cannot dynamically detect runtime tool failure patterns; this requires executable control flow to inject context-aware instructions only when the specific failure condition (all tools failed) occurs.
edits.trigger_condition: Every step where len(actions) > 0 and every action resulted in a tool_failure_reason being detected.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000001, roi_crop failed. The agent would have received the CRITICAL prompt, likely preventing it from accepting LLaVA-Med's negative finding without further visual verification. (preservative) Success cases like q000003 where tools succeed or are not used will not trigger this path, preserving direct reasoning habits. (transfer) Generalizes to any task where high-resolution inspection tools fail due to backend errors, a common infrastructure issue.
edits.regression_risk: Low. Only activates on total tool failure steps. If the agent is already stuck, this provides a clear directive rather than leaving it to guess.
edits.mechanism: Adding a next_prompt override when all requested tools fail prevents the agent from proceeding with low-confidence negative consensus by explicitly directing it to re-examine original pixels.
